steps.name: 시험 시트 zopssheet 만들기(B1:B20 = A*2 · C1 = SUM)
g1. 셀 하나 고침 → POST /api/ops 의 cell 작업(PUT 없음) · 서버에 값
steps.js: if(!window.__of){window.__of=window.fetch.bind(window);window.__reqs=[];window.fetch=async(u,o={})=>{const url=String(u),m=String(o.method||'GET').toUpperCase(),rec={m,url,body:o.body?String(o.body):''},isOps=m==='POST'&&url.includes('/api/ops/');if(m!=='GET'&&/\/api\/(ops|deck)\//.test(url))window.__reqs.push(rec);if(isOps){if(window.__opsBase){const b=JSON.parse(o.body);b.base=window.__opsBase;o={...o,body:JSON.stringify(b)};rec.body=o.body;}if(window.__opsMock){rec.res={status:window.__opsMock};return new Response(JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:'mock'}),{status:window.__opsMock,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});}if(window.__opsDelay)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,window.__opsDelay));}const r=await window.__of(u,o);if(isOps){try{rec.res=await r.clone().json();rec.res.status=r.status;}catch(e){}}return r;};}const N=window.NexaSheet,S=N.S,X=N.x;const idle=()=>until(async()=>(!S.dirty&&!S.saving&&document.querySelector('#status').textContent==='저장됨'),10000);const srv=async(id)=>{const r=await window.__of('/api/deck/'+id,{cache:'no-store'});return {v:r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'),d:await r.json()};};const ext=async(id,fn)=>{const {v,d}=await srv(id);fn(d);const p=await window.__of('/api/deck/'+id+'?base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other-window'},body:JSON.stringify(d)});return p.status;};const put=(k,v)=>X.mutate(()=>{const c=X.sheet().cells;if(v===undefined)delete c[k];else c[k]=v;});const saves=()=>window.__reqs.map(r=>r.m+' '+(r.url.includes('/api/ops/')?'ops':(r.url.match(/[?&](force|merge|action)=[^&]*/g)||[]).join('')));window.__nxOpsMin=0;await idle();window.__reqs.length=0;put('D1','고침');await idle();const o=window.__reqs.find(r=>r.url.includes('/api/ops/'));const ops=o?JSON.parse(o.body).ops:[];const {d}=await srv('zopssheet');return saves().join('|')==='POST ops'&&ops.some(x=>x.op==='cell'&&x.key==='D1')&&d.sheets[0].cells.D1==='고침'?true:JSON.stringify({saves:saves(),ops,D1:d.sheets[0].cells.D1});

steps.name: g2. 계산식이 걸린 칸(A1 → B1·C1) 고침 - 작업 목록에 섞이는 계산값(v) 수
